## Slack Automated Onboarding Guide

Drip-feed onboarding content at milestones.

**Milestones:** Day 1, 3, 7, 14, 30

**Flow:**
1. Daily 9AM trigger
2. Read new hire list from Sheets
3. Calculate days since start date
4. Match milestone (1/3/7/14/30)
5. DM relevant resources to new hire
6. Track progress in Sheets

**Sheet columns:**
name, start_date, slack_user_id
